spanish: Y tomará ezov y mojará en las aguas varón puro, y rociará sobre la tienda y sobre todos los utensilios y sobre las almas que fueron allá, y sobre el tocante en el hueso o en el traspasado o en el muerto o en el sepulcro.

findings.issue: ezov leaves the common noun אֵזוֹב untranslated; a non-name must be Spanish.
fueron allá means they went there; הָיוּ is qal perfect of be and שָׁם is locative there, so they were there.
varón puro is postponed after mojará; lack of personal a still marks him as the agent of the 3ms chain rather than its object.
findings.spanishSpan: tomará ezov y mojará en las aguas varón puro, y rociará

notes: Tent, vessels, souls, and the or-chain of bone, slain, dead, and grave match number, person, and definiteness.
